findings.sentence: MONARCH 3's is two-sided and was judged against .034 , not .05: its cumulative two-sided type I error of 0.05 was divided between the intention-to-treat population and a visceral-disease subgroup, and spent across interim and final analyses under a Lan–DeMets spending function with an O'Brien–Fleming boundary.
findings.why: The MONALEESA-2 source note on this same page describes a one-sided stratified log-rank test for MONALEESA-2, but the sentence about MONARCH 3 being 'two-sided' contradicts the MONARCH 3 source note which says 'The trial maintained a cumulative two-sided type I error of 0.05' — that is consistent; however the changed sentence says MONARCH 3's test 'is two-sided' while the MONARCH 3 source note entry for MONALEESA-2 final OS describes a one-sided test, creating no direct contradiction there. The actual contradiction is that this sentence says the cumulative type I error 'was divided between the intention-to-treat population and a visceral-disease subgroup, and spent across interim and final analyses,' but the source note for MONARCH 3 says 'with alpha divided between the intention-to-treat population and a visceral-disease subgroup by a prespecified graphical testing procedure' — these are consistent. Re-examining: the sentence says MONARCH 3's test 'is two-sided' but the page's MONALEESA-2 source note says its test is one-sided with a two-sided p reported, while the MONARCH 3 source note confirms two-sided — no contradiction found on closer reading.

dispositions.reason: Both passages describe one fact from the ledger (S011, fragment_only): every direct route to the PALMARES-2 paper was refused by the publisher on 31 August and what the page carries came through an automated search route. 'The paper is not open to us' in the note and 'every direct route we tried was refused' in the body are the same statement at two lengths, not a contradiction; neither says the paper is categorically inaccessible. Rejected on the record rather than reworded, because rewording the note again is outside what was authorised; flagged to the operator as a wording the model misread. Operator authorisation of 12 September 2026.
